title: Failure of reasonableness below the threshold
statement: For every natural number $n$ and real number $B<2^n$, let a Boolean random variable equal true with probability $2^{-n}$ and false otherwise, and let its real-valued indicator be $1$ on true and $0$ on false. This variable is not reasonable with parameter $B$.
